heuristics.name: Strict Weekly Cadence & Cooldown Guard
heuristics.rule: Never dispatch The Thursday Radar more than once within a 6-day window (minimum 518,400 seconds). Prevents duplicate broadcasts.
heuristics.impact: Eliminates subscriber fatigue and avoids duplicate delivery.

heuristics.name: Brand Saturation Cooldown (60-Day Window)
heuristics.rule: Never feature the same software brand in the Architectural Teardown slot within 60 days of its last dispatch.
heuristics.impact: Maintains high open rates and continuous content freshness.

heuristics.name: Pilier 3 Marketplace Monetization Coupling
heuristics.rule: Every newsletter edition must feature a verified marketplace blueprint (80/20 creator split) or an exclusive high-yield partner offer.
heuristics.impact: Converts newsletter readership into direct digital goods gross merchandise value (GMV).

heuristics.name: Cross-Category Wave Balancing
heuristics.rule: Rotate topics across 6 key pillars (AI IDEs, Voice AI, Databases, Automation, Outbound CRM, Product Ops) in non-consecutive succession.
heuristics.impact: Ensures broad appeal across technical CTOs, RevOps heads, and engineering managers.
